phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when you see the opponent's tech choice or if they apply early pressure.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Develop economy and tech, strengthen ground, maintain defense, scout for tech.
phase_policies.target: Maintain defensive posture while continuing to expand and tech. Strengthen ground army with additional Marines and possibly Marauders. Keep scouting for tech switches.
phase_policies.title: Early Ground Defense and Economy
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to a tech switch or abandon ground defense based on incomplete enemy information.

phase_policies.applies_when: At around 240 seconds, you have a heavy economy, heavy production, and heavy tech investment. Your army is ground-oriented with Reapers. The opponent shows a ground posture with Stalkers, moderate production, and heavy tech.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when you see a tech switch (e.g., Phoenix, Oracle, or Colossus) or when the opponent's army size becomes threatening.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Develop economy and tech, strengthen ground, add production, maintain defense, scout.
phase_policies.target: Continue developing economy and tech. Strengthen ground army composition. Consider adding production structures to support a larger army. Maintain defensive positioning while scouting for tech switches.
phase_policies.title: Ground Macro with Heavy Tech
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to a tech switch or abandon ground defense based on incomplete enemy information.

phase_policies.applies_when: At around 540 seconds, you have a heavy ground army with Siege Tanks, Marines, Reapers, and Hellions. Your economy and tech are heavy. The opponent has a ground army with Stalkers, Sentries, Observers, and Immortals, and heavy production.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck if the opponent transitions to heavy air (e.g., Phoenix, Void Rays) or if you need to respond to a specific threat.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Increase air, strengthen ground, add Medivacs, maintain economy.
phase_policies.target: Increase air presence to gain mobility and support ground army. Continue strengthening ground composition. Consider adding Medivacs for healing and drops. Maintain economic growth.
phase_policies.title: Ground Army with Air Transition
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to air transition without ensuring ground army strength and economy.

phase_policies.applies_when: At around 600 seconds, you have a heavy ground army with Siege Tanks, Marines, and Medivacs. Your economy and tech are heavy. The opponent has a ground army with Stalkers, Sentries, Observers, and Immortals, and heavy production.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when you have a decisive army advantage or if the opponent makes a tech switch.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Stabilize, increase defense, maintain army, continue economy, add Medivacs.
phase_policies.target: Focus on stabilizing your position. Increase defensive structures and maintain army strength. Continue economic growth but prioritize safety. Consider adding more Medivacs for sustain.
phase_policies.title: Stabilization and Defense
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to expansion or tech while neglecting defense and army safety.

experiment_feedback.use_boundary: Prioritize execution risks only; never infer the strategic target from agent outcomes.
